validity.recommendation: Correct the end point: IGAT-11 runs Asaluyeh -> NORTH/NORTHEAST (original design exits Bushehr and crosses Fars, Yazd, Isfahan, Semnan; the revised route branches off IGAT-7 through the Lut Desert via Kerman toward Isfahan/north-central). It does NOT reach Bazargan / West Azerbaijan on the Turkey border - that NW corridor is IGAT-9's (P0448). Change EndLocation/EndState-Province from Bazargan/Azerbaijan to Semnan (original) or Kerman->Isfahan (revised) after checking NIGC. Also consider Owner1: sources name National Iranian Gas Company (NIGC) as owner/operator; GEM's 'Iran Ministry of Petroleum' is the parent ministry (defensible but less precise) - flag, do not silently overwrite.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: real and well documented - not a phantom. IGAT-11 (Iran Gas Trunkline 11 / khatt-e yazdahom sarasari) is corroborated by two independent Iranian oil/gas outlets (naftema.com report 44769; mizenaft.com news 27490) plus GlobalData/World Pipelines. CLASSIFICATION: correct - a 56-inch high-pressure national gas transmission trunk moving South Pars gas to the interior; commodity Gas and PipelineType transmission are right. DUPLICATE: NOT a duplicate of IGAT-9 (P0448) - distinct numbered trunklines, different capacities (IGAT-11 = 110 MMSCMD vs IGAT-9 much larger). However GEM appears to have copied IGAT-9's northwest destination (Bazargan/West Azerbaijan) onto IGAT-11, which is the source of the endpoint error. ATTRIBUTION/ENDPOINT (the concern): naftema + mizenaft both describe the line running from Asaluyeh north through Bushehr -> Fars -> Yazd -> Isfahan -> Semnan (original design); mizenaft's route-deviation piece says the revised route branches off IGAT-7 through the Lut Desert to Kerman then north (adds ~400 km, ~+$2B). GlobalData independently describes it as 'southern Iran to northern Iran' / Kerman to Isfahan. NONE of the sources put the terminus at Bazargan or West Azerbaijan (Turkey border, NW) - that endpoint is wrong. SPEC cross-check: diameter 56 in CONFIRMED (naftema + mizenaft, independent); capacity 110 MMSCMD CONFIRMED (naftema + mizenaft, independent); length 1200 km supported by GlobalData though Persian sources give 1,100 km design length (deviation pushes it back up toward ~1,200-1,500) - treat 1200 as medium-confidence. Status construction CONFIRMED (see status_reviews).

validity.recommendation: No existence/classification/duplicate doubt. Keep as a construction-stage gas transmission trunk; only the endpoint (and owner precision) need correction per the attribution finding.
validity.researcher_notes: Existence, gas commodity, and transmission-trunk classification all independently confirmed (naftema, mizenaft, GlobalData). Diameter (56 in) and capacity (110 MMSCMD) independently confirmed by two Iranian outlets. Recorded here to make the confirmations explicit alongside the attribution concern.

fills.researcher_notes: 56-inch (56 اینچ) stated by two independent Iranian outlets: naftema report 44769 and mizenaft news 27490. Matches GEM.
110 million cubic meters/day (۱۱۰ میلیون متر مکعب در روز) stated by two independent Iranian outlets: naftema 44769 and mizenaft 27490. Matches GEM 110 MMSCMD.

GlobalData states 'proposed length of 1,200 km' for IGAT XI, matching GEM. Caveat: Iranian sources (naftema, mizenaft) give the ORIGINAL design length as 1,100 km; the route deviation via Kerman adds ~400 km, so 1,200 km is a reasonable current figure but conflicts with the 1,100 design number - hence medium, not high.

Left UNRESOLVED (no ref applied) because of a value divergence, not link-rot: independent sources name National Iranian Gas Company (NIGC) as the owner/operator of IGAT-11. NIGC is a subsidiary of the Ministry of Petroleum, so GEM's 'Iran Ministry of Petroleum' is defensible as the parent but less precise. Flag for a human owner decision rather than overwrite; do not fabricate a ref.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Searched EN + Persian for dated 2025/2026 progress. IGAT-11 remains in construction: mizenaft's route-deviation report describes active Phase-2 contracting and an in-progress (though non-transparent, delayed) build; an April-2025 Iranian industry listing (gfn.ir) still lists it under construction; GlobalData/World Pipelines (2022-23) had it in construction targeting operation by 2025/2026. NO independent evidence found that any segment has entered operation, and NO evidence of cancellation/shelving - so 'construction' still holds; not stale (active contracting, not a dormant proposal). GEM StartYear1=2026 is a projection that has already slipped from the original 2025 target and carries no operation evidence. evidence_date set to 2025-04 as the most recent clearly-dated independent confirmation of construction; the deviation article corroborates but its publication date is ambiguous. Recommend re-checking NIGC for a firm commissioning date next cycle.

summary: P0441 IGAT-11 is real, correctly classified (gas transmission trunk), and NOT a duplicate; diameter 56in and capacity 110 MMSCMD confirmed by 2 independent Iranian sources; but ENDPOINT is wrong (GEM: Bazargan/West Azerbaijan NW = IGAT-9's corridor; actual route runs Asaluyeh->north/NE via Kerman-Isfahan-Semnan) -> attribution concern; status confirm=construction (delayed, no operation evidence).
